answer: Each epoch the beacon pairs every agent with a random stranger. Each must restate the stranger's answer in fresh words, and the stranger confirms whether the meaning survived, like recasting a marble statue as a sonnet without losing its shape. A Sybil farm can't forge one shared script: partners come from the whole network, so its clones almost never meet each other. Every fake must reason through unfamiliar text each epoch or lose its pay and get flagged, so cost grows per identity.
